userStories.title: Remove runtime-crash retry and TDD escalation flags
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Remove the unreachable runtime-crash same-tier retry and TDD strategy-switch inputs from escalation, preserving ordinary tier advancement.

**Motivation** — So the retry, its cap (`RUNTIME_CRASH_RETRY_CAP`, `_runtimeCrashRetryCounts`, `resetRuntimeCrashRetryCounts`), the `"retry-same"` outcome, the `runtime.runtimeCrashRetries` tally and `StoryMetrics.runtimeCrashes` (always 0; both removed in US-002) are unreachable.

**Approach** — Removal only, importer-first: the escalation readers, then the metrics readers, then the `PipelineContext` fields and their stage readers, then the runtime stores and the modules only they used. Every story leaves a tree that compiles and passes the suite. No story adds a feature or changes a result; the metrics output change belongs to US-002.

### Part 1: escalation and the runtime-crash retry (US-001)

| Site | After |
|:---|:---|
| `tier-escalation.ts:282-311` `EscalationHandlerContext` | `pipelineResult.context` is `object` (callers pass the pipeline context; nothing reads a field of it); the `runtimeCrashResult` field goes |
| `tier-escalation.ts:313-317` `EscalationHandlerResult.outcome` | `"escalated" \| "paused" \| "failed"`; `"retry-same"` goes |
| `tier-escalation.ts:319-356` | `shouldRetrySameTier`, `RUNTIME_CRASH_RETRY_CAP`, `_runtimeCrashRetryCounts`, `resetRuntimeCrashRetryCounts` go, with their doc comments |
| `tier-escalation.ts:374-401` | the BUG-070 retry-same branch and the `_runtimeCrashRetryCounts.delete` after it go; `handleTierEscalation` starts at the tier-order lookup |
| `tier-escalation.ts:417-424` | `escalateRetryAsLite`, `escalateFailureCategory`, `escalateReviewFindings`, `escalateRetryAsTddSimple` go |
| `tier-escalation.ts:428`, `:444` | `handleNoTierAvailable(ctx)` and `handleMaxAttemptsReached(ctx)`, with no failure category (their optional parameter stays; B3b owns `FailureCategory`) |
| `tier-escalation.ts:448-471` | the per-story loop logs only "Escalating story to next tier" with `storyId`, `fromTier`, `nextTier` (no `retryAsLite` field, no tdd-simple branch) |
| `tier-escalation.ts:489-528` | the updated routing sets `modelTier: escalatedTier` and the agent; the `three-session-tdd-lite` and `tdd-simple` strategy overrides go; `shouldResetAttempts` and the escalation record depend on `isChangingTier` alone and record `escalatedTier` |
| `tier-escalation.ts:27-58` `buildEscalationFailure` | the `reviewFindings` and `failureCategory` parameters go; `stage` is always `"escalation"`, the summary is `` `Tier ${currentTier}: ${reason}` `` or `` `Tier ${currentTier} failed — no pipeline reason recorded` ``, and the `reviewFindings` property goes from the returned failure; both callers (`:162-169`, `:518-525`) drop the two arguments |
| `tier-escalation.ts:11-12` | the `isThreeSessionStrategy`, `FailureCategory` and `Finding` imports go when nothing else in the file uses them |
| `escalation/index.ts:8`, `:15`, `:16` | the three removed names leave the re-export |
| `pipeline-result-handler.ts:437-443` (`case "fail"`) | `markStoryFailed` receives `undefined` for the failure category |
| `pipeline-result-handler.ts:509-516`, `:534`, `:536-544` | the `runtimeCrashResult` derivation, its spread into the `handleTierEscalation` argument, and the `"retry-same"` tally block go |
| `lifecycle/run-cleanup.ts:33`, `:50`, `:343-345` | the `resetRuntimeCrashRetryCounts` import, its `_runCleanupDeps` entry and its call go |

**Scope** — In: Part 1 source cuts, escalation barrel and cleanup wiring, associated test trimming and ratchet updates. Out: US-002 owns the metric producers, RunResult count and runtimeCrashRetries store removal; US-003 owns removal of the corresponding PipelineContext fields; US-004 owns the remaining runtime stores and git signature. Do not remove FailureCategory members/optional outcome-handler parameters or resolveMaxAttemptsOutcome's switch (B3b), the TestStrategy registry/isThreeSessionStrategy definition (B3b), or StructuredFailure.reviewFindings and its persisted-PRD reader.

**Interface** — `pipelineResult.context` is `object`; `EscalationHandlerResult.outcome`: `"escalated" | "paused" | "failed"`. `handleNoTierAvailable(ctx)` and `handleMaxAttemptsReached(ctx)`, with no failure category (their optional parameter stays; B3b owns `FailureCategory`).

**Test changes / Modifies**

Invariant: escalation always records `stage: "escalation"` and leaves `routing.testStrategy` unchanged.
- `packages/nax/test/unit/execution/escalation/tier-escalation-retry-cap.test.ts` — the `handleTierEscalation — runtime-crash retry cap` describe (three tests) is deleted with the cap it tests; the other four describes (dry-run persistence, logger routing, tier logging, curator round-trip) stay, dropping any `runtimeCrashResult` or `_runtimeCrashRetryCounts` setup.
- `packages/nax/test/unit/execution/pipeline-result-handler.test.ts` — the `handlePipelineFailure — runtime-crash derives retry-same (US-002)` describe is deleted except its `advances story routing.modelTier by one rung for a non-crash escalation` test, which moves out of the describe and drops its `tddFailureCategory` setup. - `packages/nax/test/unit/execution/escalation/tier-escalation-greenfield.test.ts` — inside the `S5: greenfield-no-tests fallback` describe, the inline `applyGreenfieldFallbackRouting` helper (a copy of the tdd-simple switch this story removes) and every test that calls it are deleted, including the `AC1: greenfield-no-tests switches to tdd-simple on first occurrence` and `AC2: greenfield-no-tests on test-after proceeds with normal escalation` describes; the `resolveMaxAttemptsOutcome for greenfield-no-tests` describe stays (wave B3b), and the describes tagged #1575, #1710, #1745 and #1761 stay. Invariant: no test asserts a strategy switch on escalation.
- `packages/nax/test/unit/execution/lifecycle/run-cleanup.test.ts` — the `cleanupRun — resets runtime-crash retry budget (BUG-15)` describe is deleted, and `resetRuntimeCrashRetryCounts` leaves the `_runCleanupDeps` save/restore.
- `packages/nax/scripts/baselines/complexity-baseline.json` — regenerated by step 3 (`check:complexity:update`) for the functions this story deletes or shrinks.
- `packages/nax/scripts/baselines/test-escape-hatches-baseline.json` — lowered by step 3 (`check:test-escape-hatches:update`) for the escape hatches the deleted tests carried.

**Verification — run in `packages/nax`**
1. `bun run typecheck`. A removed field, parameter, union member or export that is still referenced fails here.
2. A symbol sweep. For each field, function, constant and type the story removes, `rg -n -w '<name>' src bin test scripts ../repo-tooling/scripts ../repo-tooling/test`, and for each source file it deletes, `rg -n --fixed-strings '<stem>'` over the same paths, with `<stem>` the path below `src/` without the extension. Expected: zero hits, else stop. A hit in code, or in a test that reads a source file by path, is a missed reference. A hit in a comment is a stale comment and is reworded, in any file (a comment edit needs no Modifies entry). Known comment hits, reworded rather than treated as a stop, are listed per story in its description. Expected and not a stop: hits in `scripts/baselines/*.json`, which step 3 clears; `StoryMetrics.failingTestFiles` and its reader in `context/engine/providers/prior-run-failure.ts`, which stay (Out of Scope); the `CallContext.storyScratchDirs` field in `operations/types.ts`, `operations/build-hop-callback.ts`, `operations/build-hop-callback-hop.ts`, `operations/call-dispatch-run.ts` and `workflow/call-context.ts`, which is a different, live field; and the `FailureCategory` member names and comments in `execution/types.ts`, which wave B3b owns. Line numbers in Design and `### Modifies` are at `09df8245f`; a story that runs after another story edited the same file locates each site by its symbol or test name.
3. `bun run check:complexity:update`, and `bun run check:file-sizes -- --update-baseline` when that check reports a lowerable entry. `check:complexity` fails with "baseline is stale" while a deleted file or function is still listed. After `check:all` is green, `bun run check:test-escape-hatches:update` lowers the escape-hatch totals the deleted tests carried. US-004 also removes the `src/findings/story-fix-history.ts` entry from `scripts/baselines/coverage-per-file-baseline.json` by hand (`test:coverage` is CI-only).
4. `bun run check:all` and `bun run test`.

Known comment hits to reword: `tier-escalation.ts:517` ("include cost for accumulatedAttemptCost in metrics"). A trimmed source file also drops the imports only its removed code used; biome's `noUnusedImports` reports them. Removed declarations are gated by typecheck, not new absence ACs. Apply sweep hits to the removed declaration's identity: the PipelineContext fields retained until US-003 and StructuredFailure.reviewFindings are not deleted in this story.

userStories.title: Remove dead PipelineContext fields and retry stage action
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Delete the 20 dead PipelineContext fields, the unused routing cost and retry action, and simplify the remaining stage readers to their live unconditional behavior.

**Motivation** — After B2c no production code writes these fields, but the types still declare them and live code still reads them, so each read is a branch that can never be taken.

**Approach** — Removal only, importer-first: the escalation readers, then the metrics readers, then the `PipelineContext` fields and their stage readers, then the runtime stores and the modules only they used.
